review_completed.description: True ONLY if the review actually ran to completion. Used as the non-run / fake-green sentinel by the gate.

verdict.description: block if any P0 or P1 finding exists, otherwise pass.

summary.description: Short plain-text overview of what was reviewed and concluded.

findings.description: One entry per issue found. Empty array when the PR is clean.

file.description: Repo-relative path, or null if not file-specific.

line.description: Line number, or null if not line-specific.

rule.description: The contract rule violated (e.g. 'Invariant W3', 'AGENTS.md P0.3', 'PR1').

explanation.description: Concrete, contract-grounded reason for the finding.
